_comment: Hand-maintained Landes-Amtstraeger (Stand 2026-11-21). Only entries verified from a named public source are listed; unverified offices are left out on purpose. Version 1 lists only the head of government per Land: Fraktionsvorsitzende are deliberately not included (equal treatment of parties; not verified for all Laender). Fields: land (Kuerzel), name, party (PartyId), role, source (URL) + note (what the source says). scripts/people.mjs adds id/profileUrl (Abgeordnetenwatch politician id looked up by exact name; see there).
